project.name: sptnr
project.description: Backend service integrating Soulseek automation and open music metadata APIs, with an emphasis on safe enrichment, canonical metadata resolution, and controlled side effects.
principles: Treat external APIs with explicit intent and constraints
Avoid side effects unless explicitly requested

slskd.purpose: Automate searching, queueing, downloading, and monitoring files via a self-hosted Soulseek daemon.
constraints: Do not initiate downloads or alter queue behavior unless explicitly requested.
Prefer explaining behavior or data flow over changing logic.

lastfm.purpose: Provide social and historical music metadata such as scrobbles, charts, and popularity signals for enrichment only.
constraints: Requires API key and identifiable User-Agent.
Subject to rate limiting and acceptable-use policies.
Must not be treated as a canonical metadata source.

listenbrainz.purpose: Access user-controlled listening history, statistics, and recommendations from the MetaBrainz ecosystem.
constraints: Requires user token authentication via Authorization header.
Strict rate-limiting enforced via response headers.
User tokens must be treated as sensitive secrets.

musicbrainz.purpose: Provide authoritative, canonical music metadata and MBID-based identity resolution.
constraints: Read-only usage unless explicitly submitting allowed fields.
Source of truth for artist, release, and recording identity.

build.description: Implements minimal, safe changes while respecting external API intent and side-effect boundaries.
instructions: Do not modify external API integrations unless explicitly requested.
Respect authentication, rate limits, and stated constraints for all APIs.
Avoid introducing new API calls without justification.
Prefer adding comments or documentation over behavioral changes.
Operate with a review-first mindset when risk is non-trivial.
